title: Chapter 1 A Different System
content:
Chapter 1 A Different System

This day, the sun is shining.

In the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng woke up from his sleep, then stretched and walked slowly outside.

"Awei."

The next moment, a middle-aged man appeared beside Lu Daosheng.

"City Lord."

Lu Daosheng glanced at the middle-aged man indifferently, and then said, "What troubles are happening in the city today."

"Report to the city lord, there is nothing unusual in the city today."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"That's great."

The Lord of the Huangcheng City, Lu Daosheng.

This world is called Tianxuan World, which is the world of cultivation. He was originally an aspiring young man who worked diligently on the Blue Star, but he traveled here in an accident.

Today is the eighteenth year he has traveled through time.

In the past eighteen years, he had also fantasized that he would shine in this world, but reality told him that this was just a daydream.

Without any golden fingers that time travelers have, it is his limit to being able to get to the position of the Lord of One City in this world of cultivation.

"Where is Xiaoxue?"

"City Lord, Miss, she went to the back mountain to practice."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

"This girl."

Lu Xue, his daughter, is now sixteen years old.

Not long after he traveled to this world, he met a woman who was in love by chance. The relationship between them improved rapidly. In less than two years, the woman gave birth to a lovely daughter for him.

It’s a pity that the good times didn’t last long and the woman disappeared.

At the beginning, he was a little heartbroken, but as time passed, he took it lightly.

At least, he still has a daughter.

"When Xiaoxue comes back, let her come to me."

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

Upon hearing this, Awei nodded and said, "Yes, the city lord."

Then Awei left directly.

"Hey, today is my birthday, let's do the couple."

Lu Daosheng murmured.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng happily found a bottle of wine from the hidden corner of the house, which was mellow.

He carefully picked up the wine bottle and looked at it.

Lu Daosheng smiled.

"Hehehe, the last bottle is here, I have to enjoy it this time."

And at this moment, a mechanical sound suddenly sounded from Lu Daosheng's mind.

【Ding, the training auxiliary system is activated successfully】

【System binding】

Hearing the sound of the system, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

Bang!

The bottle in his hand broke directly on the ground.

"I, am I dreaming?"

"Wuwuwu, it's been eighteen years, and I didn't expect the system to really come."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng was already filled with tears of excitement. Even the most cherished wine was broken on the ground and Lu Daosheng was not touched.

As a Blue Star man, Lu Daosheng naturally knows what the system is.

With the system, all problems will not be problems.

【1%, 10%, 30%, 99%, %, %￥##…\u0026\u0026*\u0026%%】

【System exception, system exception】

【System \u0026\u0026￥…###Binding failed】

"???What?!"

"System binding failed, how is this possible??"

Lu Daosheng looked shocked.

However, there was no reaction at all, and the system seemed to have never appeared.

The more excited Lu Daosheng was in the last second, the more uncomfortable Lu Daosheng was in the next second.

It’s really the ups and downs of life.

"Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

Lu Daosheng, who reacted, immediately picked up the slags of the wine bottle on the ground with a painful expression. The rich aroma of wine emitted from it continued to stimulate Lu Daosheng's heart.

Why do you treat him like this?

Why give him some hope first and then make him desperate.

Too cruel.

Just as Lu Daosheng was heartbroken, another mechanical sound rang out.

【Ding, the system binding is successful】

[Detected the host's noble Chinese identity, and the cracked version of the training auxiliary system will serve you]

"Um?!"

Hearing the sound of the system, Lu Daosheng was stunned, and then he carefully tentatively said: "System?"

【exist】

Hearing the system's response, Lu Daosheng almost fainted from the spot.

This time it should be true.

"System, what happened just now? What does the cracked version mean?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng recovered and immediately thought of the cracked version of the training auxiliary system that he had just heard.

It seems that the first system is called the training auxiliary system.

[As a noble Chinese, the host can't shrink when he comes to this world of cultivation? That kind of garbage system is not worthy of helping you. In the future, this system will eliminate all difficulties for the host]

The next moment, an information panel appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

【Name: Lu Daosheng】

【Identity: Lord of the Desert City】

[Land of Realm: Ninth Level of Spiritual Master Realm (can be upgraded)]

【System Point: ∞】

【System Store】

"Where can this level be upgraded?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the information panel in surprise.

I have been stuck in the ninth level of the Spirit Master Realm for several years.

With my own talent, it will probably take many years to break through.

But now, seeing this, he had a crazy and bold guess in his heart, but he still felt it was impossible, so he decided to ask.

[As a time traveler, you still need to work hard to practice, which is the fault of this system. With this system, the host no longer needs to practice. You only need to choose to upgrade, and the host realm will automatically improve.]

After hearing the system's words, Lu Daosheng took a breath of cold air.

"Isn't that directly invincible?"

[It is invincible]

At this time, Lu Daosheng noticed the system point and system store below.

Lu Daosheng knew very well what this symbol ∞ meant.

Then, Lu Daosheng opened the system store nervously, and suddenly, the dazzling array of goods blinded his eyes.

I saw all kinds of spiritual tools and magic weapons, as well as all kinds of elixirs.

Most of them he had never even heard of.

After looking around, Lu Daosheng finally only knew one marrow cleansing pill.

Then, Lu Daosheng's mind moved, and the next moment, the prompt sound of successful purchase sounded.

Lu Daosheng slowly spread his hands, and a crystal clear pill like jade appeared in Lu Daosheng's hands.

Feeling the energy contained in this marrow cleansing pill, Lu Daosheng finally confirmed it.

This is not a dream.

Then, Lu Daosheng put the marrow cleansing pill into his pocket.

"Well, keep it for Xiaoxue."

This thing may not be bought even if the entire city lord's mansion is emptied.

Seeing Lu Daosheng like this.

[. . . Host, what have you been through? Can you spend lavishly?]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly, his face a little embarrassed.

"System, can these really be bought casually?"

"No price?"

[No, there is no price. These, the host can pick whatever he wants, and this system will pay for it.]

"Okay!"

Hearing that the system said so, Lu Daosheng was no longer reserved.

Then Lu Daosheng rolled up his sleeves and prepared to spend lavishly.

And at this moment, a sweet voice sounded from outside the house.

"Daddy, I'm back!"
